embeddingSpace.reduction: leading-dimension truncation followed by L2 renormalization (MOD-04)

conversion.kind: third-party ONNX conversion of the source checkpoint
conversion.note: The unquantized fp32 onnx weights — the fused model plus the vision and audio encoders, each with their external onnx_data — measured on this host: sizes and SHA-256s below are the files actually downloaded, verified and run (MOD-01).

engine.kind: onnxruntime-node (native CPU execution provider) driven by @huggingface/transformers
engine.note: The ONNX session is created DIRECTLY over the pinned model.onnx (the custom embedding_gemma2 architecture has no dedicated transformers.js class), and the conversion's shipped GemmaTokenizer is loaded through transformers' AutoTokenizer — the packages the qualified route executed, not a semver range (MOD-19).

tokenizer.identity: ships with the conversion at the pinned revision; vocab_size 262144
tokenizer.note: Measured from the pinned files: tokenizer_class GemmaTokenizer. The tokenizer identity is part of the embedding-space descriptor (MOD-03).

processor.note: MOD-06 remainder, recorded honestly: the conversion ships no prompt template, so purpose/role are validated by the extension but NOT prefixed into the model input. Whether the source checkpoint's card prescribes per-role prefixes is not verified against the card on this host; a golden processor fixture remains unrecorded until it is.

groups.note: The text backbone, its tokenizer and its config, measured (MOD-01). A text-only load requires EXACTLY this group — the MOD-02 boundary, pinned by the extension's real-path test; the vision and audio weights are neither required nor fetched.

The vision encoder and the pinned image preprocessing (960x672 canonical grid, patch 16, pooling 3, 1/255 rescale). The encoder's observed signature: pixel_values [1, 2520, 768] flattened patches plus pixel_position_ids [1, 2520, 2]; the position-id formula is a RECONSTRUCTION recorded in the qualification record. The video half of this group stays the third-slice remainder.

The audio encoder and the pinned 16 kHz mel preprocessing (128 bins, 512 FFT, 320/160 frame/hop, 8 kHz max). The bounded Node WAV decoder and spectrogram live in the extension (src/media.ts); the conversion's own load_audio helper relies on browser APIs, which is exactly the gap this group's decoder fills.

pinning.reason: The text backbone (five files), the vision encoder (two files plus the shared processor config) and the audio encoder (two files plus the feature-extractor config) were downloaded, hashed and RUN on this host; the qualification record at docs/tool-mode/qualification/embeddinggemma.json carries the measurements. The audio_encoder.onnx_data SHA-256 was verified against the pin after the full download completed (1,172,750,848 bytes). The audio prompt block is VARIABLE-LENGTH: one soft token per encoder feature row (measured 119 mel frames -> 30 rows for the 1.2 s fixture), never the fixed 280-token maximum. All prepared files are the FP32 variants; the fp16/q4/q4f16/quantized variants exist at the same revision and are NOT prepared. Video frame sampling stays the third-slice remainder.

embeddinggemma-2-onnx.platformNote: MOD-19's target is plain built JavaScript on Windows x64 CPU. Other platforms are declared in the manifest only once a run exists there, because a platform table is not proof of correct inference (MODEL-05).

network.when: once, during asset preparation by the host, before any inference
network.note: The extension itself performs no network call: the host acquires and verifies the pinned bytes and hands the extension local paths (PreparedAssetMapV1). The manifest therefore declares network.otherNetworkUse true while permissions.networkOrigins stays empty.

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.note: Apache-2.0 is a redistribution-permitting, OSI-approved licence, which is why this package's weights layer differs from the Desert Ant packages' source-available weights. The declaration records what the model card states; it was not re-verified against the card on this host.

embeddinggemma-2-onnx.note: All three MOD-02 groups are now measured: the text backbone, the vision encoder and the audio encoder, each with the pinned files and digests above. The remaining unmeasured part is the VIDEO half of the vision group — frame sampling needs a video decoder, which is the recorded third slice of the media work.
